verified_facts.text: Treetops Lodge & Estate is located 20 minutes from Rotorua in secluded countryside in New Zealand's central North Island.
verified_facts.excerpt: Treetops Lodge & Estate is located 20 minutes from Rotorua, in a piece of secluded countryside in New Zealand

verified_facts.text: The estate is reserved exclusively for guests.
verified_facts.excerpt: Treetops offers a premium stay in Rotorua and is reserved exclusively for guests.

verified_facts.text: The estate features four waterfalls and lakes, seven trout streams and over 70 km (35 miles) of private hiking and adventure trails.
verified_facts.excerpt: featuring four waterfalls and lakes, seven trout streams, and over 70 km (35 miles) of private hiking and adventure trails

verified_facts.text: A guided walk through fern forest leads to Bridal Veil Falls, the lodge's own private waterfall.
verified_facts.excerpt: light trek through fern forest with your guide, opening up to the spectacular Bridal Veil Falls

verified_facts.text: Glow worm caverns are a few minutes from the main lodge.
verified_facts.excerpt: Just a few minutes from the main lodge explore the caverns of Glow worms.

verified_facts.text: In 1986, founder John Sax began acquiring land near Rotorua and restoring it by replanting native trees, establishing wetlands and protecting wildlife habitats.
verified_facts.excerpt: In 1986, he began acquiring land near Rotorua, initiating a restoration journey: replanting native trees, establishing wetlands, and protecting wildlife habitats

verified_facts.text: Treetops opened in 2001.
verified_facts.excerpt: By 2001, Treetops had opened as a boutique hotel in Rotorua

verified_facts.text: The villas are built with native timber felled and milled on-site.
verified_facts.excerpt: using native timber felled and milled on-site

verified_facts.text: Each villa has a private terrace, a fireplace and direct access to trails, lakes and streams.
verified_facts.excerpt: Each villa offers private terraces, fireplaces, and direct access to trails, lakes, and streams

verified_facts.text: Valley Villas have French doors opening to a private patio facing the Horo Bluffs.
verified_facts.excerpt: French doors opening to a private patio facing the Horo Bluffs

verified_facts.text: Pheasant Cottage is a self-catering option set apart from the other villas.
verified_facts.excerpt: Pheasant Cottage is offered as a self-catering option, set apart from the other villas.

verified_facts.text: The estate's luxury tents have premium king bedding, timber furnishings, a private ensuite and outdoor living spaces overlooking native forest.
verified_facts.excerpt: each spacious canvas sanctuary features premium king bedding, elegant timber furnishings, a private ensuite, and outdoor living spaces overlooking native forest

verified_facts.text: The spa offers private jacuzzis and massage therapy beneath native trees.
verified_facts.excerpt: private jacuzzis and massage therapy nestled underneath towering native trees

verified_facts.text: Treetops Spa treatments use estate-reared, 100% raw Manuka honey.
verified_facts.excerpt: At the heart of The Treetops Spa experience treatment is the inclusion of estate-reared, 100% raw Mānuka honey

verified_facts.text: Guests can kayak on the estate's Lake Reflection.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy a gentle kayak on Treetops’ Lake Reflection.

verified_facts.text: Heli fishing gives access to wilderness terrain not easily reached by other means.
verified_facts.excerpt: wilderness Heli fishing allowing access into wilderness terrain boasting unspoilt fishing not easily accessible by any other means

verified_facts.text: Fly fishing packages include all equipment and licenses required.
verified_facts.excerpt: Packages include all equipment and licenses required.

verified_facts.text: A guided private estate tour offers chances to view and photograph stag, water buffalo, sheep, goats and birdlife.
verified_facts.excerpt: Opportunities abound to view and photograph majestic stag, water buffalo, sheep, goats, and a variety of birdlife.

verified_facts.text: Dishes are created from organic ingredients grown on the estate.
verified_facts.excerpt: created with care from organic ingredients grown right on the estate

verified_facts.text: Felipe Ponce is the Head Chef.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join Felipe Ponce, Head Chef

verified_facts.text: Children are welcome at Treetops Lodge & Estate.
verified_facts.excerpt: Yes, children are warmly welcome at Treetops Lodge & Estate.

verified_facts.text: All activities are subject to suitable weather conditions.
verified_facts.excerpt: All activities are subject to suitable weather conditions

verified_facts.text: Weather in the Horohoro and greater Rotorua area can vary.
verified_facts.excerpt: Weather in the Horohoro and greater Rotorua area can vary.

verified_facts.text: Conservation programmes include reforestation, wildlife population management, invasive species control and collaboration with local environmental organisations.
verified_facts.excerpt: Conservation programmes include reforestation, wildlife population management, invasive species control, and collaboration with local environmental organisations

verified_facts.text: The lodge suggests a stay of three to four nights to enjoy the estate at a relaxed pace.
verified_facts.excerpt: A stay of three to four nights is ideal for enjoying the estate

verified_facts.text: The Hobbiton Movie Set is just over an hour away.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Hobbiton Movie Set is just over an hour away
